diagnostic_evidence.quote: where $\VV_{\ell}^+$ consists of the new vertices of $\TT_{\ell}$ along with their neighboring vertices in $\VV_{\ell} \cap \VV_{\ell-1}$.

issues.failure_explanation: X_l^+ is spanned by hat functions at the new vertices and at old vertices whose patch changed. Hence dim X_l^+ exceeds the number of new interior vertices, which equals dim X_l^1 - dim X_{l-1}^1 (this identity holds for NVB because every new vertex of T_l is a bisection vertex). The sum X_{l-1}^1 + X_l^+ therefore cannot be direct. Only the non-direct sum equality holds.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace ⊕ by + (a non-direct sum) and note that the decomposition is redundant.
issues.overall_effect: The stated decomposition is wrong as written. The multigrid and Schwarz arguments only need the (non-direct) sum, so the main results are not invalidated.
issues.title: Claimed direct sum X_l^1 = X_{l-1}^1 ⊕ X_l^+ is false when V_l^+ contains old vertices
issues.why_classification: A one-symbol correction suffices, and no later argument uses directness.

issues.failure_explanation: The recurrences in the PCG derivation (p^0 = B r^0, alpha_k with |r|_B) and the optimality claims require B ≈ A^{-1}. With x = B^{-1/2} x̃ and r = B^{1/2} r̃, the transformed system matrix would give p^0 = B^{-1} r^0, contradicting the stated recurrence. The identity cond_2(B^{-1/2} A B^{-1/2}) = cond_A(BA) is false for general SPD B, because the spectrum of BA coincides with that of B^{1/2} A B^{1/2}. The same wrong form is reused in the optimality corollaries.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Use the transformed matrix B^{1/2} A B^{1/2} (with x̃ = B^{-1/2} x) throughout, and cite [TW05, Thm C.1] for its spectrum equalling that of BA.
issues.overall_effect: The displayed equalities of condition numbers in the PCG reduction and in both optimality corollaries are incorrect as stated. The bounds on cond_A(BA) are unaffected.
issues.title: Spectral identity for PCG uses B^{-1/2} A B^{-1/2} although B approximates A^{-1}
issues.why_classification: The correction is a uniform change of exponent sign, and all quantitative conclusions are preserved.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: In particular, Theorem~\ref{theorem: general result} implies that $\vec{B}_{\ell}^{\MG}$ fulfills assumption~\eqref{eq: preconditioner assumption}

issues.failure_explanation: Proposition MG contraction is proved for Algorithm 2 with the optimal (capped) step sizes lambda_{l'}. The Remark replaces them by the fixed step (d+1)^{-1} and claims the same q. Theorem general result takes contraction as a hypothesis and cannot produce it. Greedy per-level optimality does not imply that the final error of the optimal-step method is no larger than that of the fixed-step method, since the intermediate residuals differ. So the contraction (eq: linearized MG contracion) for the linear operator E_l, with the same q, is not supported. It is the key input for the symmetric preconditioner.

failure_location.quote: All results of this section remain valid.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Prove contraction of the fixed-step multiplicative Schwarz error operator E_l, e.g. by the classical stable-decomposition and strengthened Cauchy–Schwarz argument with ||lambda S|| ≤ 1, possibly with a different constant q. Alternatively, cite a source that covers fixed step sizes.
issues.overall_effect: The SPD property and the h- and p-robust condition-number bound (1+q^2)/(1-q^2) for B^sMG rest on an unproved contraction estimate.
issues.title: Contraction of the fixed-step-size linearized multigrid is asserted, not established
issues.why_classification: A contained argument, using already available ingredients (stable decomposition, SCS, local overlap bounds), closes the gap, and the result is comparable.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: Employ Dörfler marking to determine a set $\MM_{\ell} \in \M_{\ell}[\theta, u_{\ell}^{\underline{k}}]

issues.failure_explanation: The marking class compares the computed estimator eta(u^{k_}) on the left with eta(U, u*_l) built from the unavailable exact discrete solution on the right. Step (ii) is therefore not executable. It also does not match the standard criterion with u_l^{k_} on both sides, which is what the cited optimal-complexity analysis (GHPS21, BFMPS23) addresses. The theorem is invoked as a black box ('we refer to'), so its hypotheses are not verified for the algorithm as written.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace u_l^* by u_l^{k_} in the Dörfler condition, which gives the standard computable criterion of the cited framework.
issues.overall_effect: As written, the algorithm is not implementable and the optimal-complexity theorem is applied to a different marking rule than the one analysed in the cited works.
issues.title: Dörfler marking in AFEM algorithm uses the exact discrete solution in the marking set
issues.why_classification: A local change of the argument of the estimator restores the cited setting, and all claims and constants are kept.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: Summing over $T \in \widehat{\TT}_k$, exploiting the existence of $z_0$, and using the discrete Cauchy-Schwarz inequality lead to

issues.failure_explanation: Step 1 gives the per-patch bound <v_k, P_z w_k> ≲ Cloc δ^{m-k} ||v_k|| ||P_z w_k|| with the global norm ||v_k||, because locality was discarded by Cauchy–Schwarz over elements. Step 2 then sums this over z, which needs sum_z ||P_z w_k|| ≲ ||w_k||. Finite overlap only gives sum_z ||w||^2_{ω(z)} ≲ ||w||^2, an l^2 bound. The l^1 sum of N comparable local norms is about sqrt(N) times the global norm, so the claimed inequality is false in general. The lemma, which carries no h-uniformity, is not proved.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Keep v_k local in Step 1 (use ||v_k||_{ω(z0)} and the local constants). Then sum over (l',z) with Cauchy–Schwarz in l^2, using the multiplicity bound Clev and finite overlap, to get sum <v_k, P_z w_k> ≲ δ^{m-k} ||v_k|| ||w_k||.
issues.overall_effect: The upper bound in the additive Schwarz theorem uses this lemma in Step 3. Hence the bound on lambda_max(B^AS A), and the AS optimality corollary with its h- and p-robust condition number, rest on an unproved estimate.
issues.title: Strengthened Cauchy–Schwarz for G_{l,m}: an l^1-sum of local norms is bounded by the global norm
issues.why_classification: The fix is a contained re-ordering of the summation using the same ingredients (local SCS, Clev, overlap). No new global architecture is needed, and the result keeps its form.
